legacy_model_scope: 200K shape replay; neither live exact TP4 program nor service/clock/engine bindings; B_red_parallel hypothetical, not adopted

conditions: empty request and response queues at start
cold initially closed bank state; refresh deadlines reset-origin
conditional_window_only.limits: Previous write/RoPE bank state is not reconstructed; these starts form sensitivity examples, not a proof of actual start or deadline.
conditional_window_only.verdict: Sensitivity replay, not formal cycle equivalence, actual request observation, or guaranteed live deadline
conditional_window_only.bound_scope: Min/max over listed deterministic cold-state scenarios ONLY; not an exhaustive start/bank-state bound or measured live counter proof.

watchdog_risk.meaning: A terminal PC24 watchdog can precede healthy cold-refill completion; do not classify that terminal as proved deadlock without causal state/producer evidence. No watchdog or runtime changed.
watchdog_risk.initialization: After priming, 64 ticks and token start, lastpc initialized ~0 and last_move=cyc. First loop sample updates last_move; every subsequent change by ANY rank resets it.
watchdog_risk.trigger: cyc-last_move > WD; WD=RT_WATCHDOG=100000; triggers on the100001st cycle since latest ANY-rank PC change, not row/sector progress.
watchdog_risk.last_move_observation: CYC12200 allPC22; CYC12400 allPC24. If unchanged thereafter, last_move is in[12201,12400], so trigger in[112202,112401]. Precise intra-checkpoint transition is not exported.
watchdog_risk.terminal_classification: Prints WATCHDOG with core state/idles/waited/CDMA words, breaks loop, dumps all4 VM arrays, prints TIMEOUT, returns1 if any rank notDONE. Does NOT set a DUT fault bit or prove circular wait; timeout must remain failed/incomplete, not exact/PASS.

required_next: Exact emitted-instruction replay with runtime engine parameters, clock counters, scalar service state/admission, collectives and write visibility; per-PC expected issue/retire comparison. Preserve watchdog terminal as incomplete if fired; no restart of live PID.
